results.q: Who is the general contractor on this project?
results.answer: **The general contractor on this project is Krause Custom Builders**, as identified in the title block of the General Notes sheet. [1][2]

results.q: Which building code and edition are the structural design criteria based on?
results.answer: **International Building Code (IBC) 2009 with Wisconsin Amendments, supplemented by ASCE 7-05**, forms the basis of the structural design criteria. This is explicitly stated in the Design Criteria section of sheet S-100. [1]

results.answer:

- **Public Areas: 100 PSF**
- Storage (Light): 125 PSF

results.q: What is the floor live load for offices?
results.answer: **The floor live load for offices is 50 PSF** (which includes a 15 PSF partition load in addition to the base load), as listed in the Design Criteria section under Floor Live Loads. [1][2]

results.q: What weld metal must the welds conform to?
results.answer: **All welds must use weld metal conforming to E70XX** (and additional requirements follow that statement). [1]
